files.description: Quiz results (80 rows, one per student in seat order, no other columns): quiz_a and quiz_b (points 0-10, whole numbers, many equal values; about 9% and 6% of cells empty for absent students).

task_text: Convert the table to the best-fitting column types after reading, so that the scores stay whole numbers with empty cells. Rank the students in quiz_a from the lowest score (rank 1 = lowest; equal scores share the average of their ranks; absent students get no rank). How many students have a rank of 10 or less? `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Count of non-empty quiz_a scores whose average ascending rank among the 73 present scores is <= 10.

predicted_direction.reason: On 2.x the absent students received ranks among the lowest and pushed the other ranks up, changing who is in the bottom ten; on 3.x they stay unranked.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
